summary: All 6 phases of plans/01_pypi-install-verification-pipeline.md are complete. code/tests/packaging/conftest.py's installed_venv fixture is now parameterized over install source via MODEL_CHECKER_PACKAGING_INSTALL_SOURCE (local default / testpypi / pypi) and MODEL_CHECKER_PACKAGING_INSTALL_VERSION (unset -> code/pyproject.toml pin / latest -> live JSON-API lookup / explicit literal), with the default (both unset) path proven byte-for-byte unchanged at every checkpoint (106 passed/4 skipped baseline -> 119 passed/4 skipped after adding 13 helper-contract tests, held identical through fixture rewiring and the final re-check). Index mode never triggers a local build (lazy request.getfixturevalue plus a pytest_collection_modifyitems not-applicable skip for the four byte-level artifact modules -- confirmed: 26 passed, 97 skipped in pypi mode, no built_artifacts fixture setup observed). .github/workflows/release.yml gained a new verify-pypi job (needs: [publish-pypi], 3x3 OS/Python matrix, fail-fast: false) that github-release now also needs; .github/workflows/pypi-smoke.yml is a new scheduled (0 7 * * *) + workflow_dispatch workflow with opt-in, failure-gated, timeout-capped tmate debugging, confirmed to appear in no other workflow's needs:. All three install sources (local/testpypi/pypi) and both version-resolution paths (exact pin, latest) were exercised live from this NixOS development host against the real published model-checker 1.3.7 artifact, including a full 13-test CLI run (entry point, console script, generate-then-execute across all four theories) through the existing _add_cxx_runtime_to_env NixOS repair -- not the libz3 skip backstop. tests/ci/ is green (83 passed). Both workflow files validated via YAML parse plus scripted structural assertions (actionlint not installed on this host; documented fallback per the plan). No publish, push, tag, or PR step was performed at any point -- verified by construction (no such command was ever run) and consistent with the delegation's non-negotiable constraint. One implementation deviation from the plan's literal wording is documented in Phase 3's and the summary's Deviations sections: pytest_collection_modifyitems reads the raw env var directly rather than calling _resolve_install_source(), because pytest.fail() raised from a collection hook surfaces as a pytest INTERNALERROR rather than a normal red test -- confirmed directly before and after the fix. Strict validation and the loud, offending-value-naming failure remain solely in _resolve_install_source(), exercised at fixture-setup time by every installed_venv-consuming test.
